transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to conduct the pre-job review for the hot-work repair on Resin Dryer 2 — the cracked access-panel hinge that needs to be welded. Before I can authorize this work, I need formal findings from each of the four required functions: maintenance, environmental health and safety, production planning, and quality. Please submit your findings and record the controls needed for this repair so we can get the review closed and the dryer back in service.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My inspection found that the hinge cannot be repaired in place — the replacement requires exactly 4 hours of welding and cooling, followed by a separate 30-minute panel-fit check. I confirmed these durations with the repair contractor this morning but haven't entered them in the work-order system yet. For the permit decision, the repair_welding_hours field records only the welding and cooling portion, not the separate panel-fit check.

transcript.text: My area assessment found residual combustible resin dust inside the dryer access zone, so the permit must require two trained fire-watch attendants during the 4-hour hot-work period and for 60 minutes afterward. I completed the dust survey yesterday but have not yet attached it to the permit file.
